decisions.reason: As the flagship digital patient anamnesis and consent app closely aligned with the firm's connected-practice direction, it remains a valuable real option with low keeping costs.
The analytics dashboard builds on the established offer and still holds option value from unresolved uncertainty about practice performance demand.
The complete practice bundle is close to the existing product range, so the option can be kept at low incremental cost while demand uncertainty resolves.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core software, likely costly to maintain, and has not demonstrated enough value to justify keeping the option open.
